generations.name: c2-energy-katana
generations.prompt:
Create ONE full-body transparent pixel-art Ranger concept for Power Agents. Reference1 is approved provider costume identity; reference2 establishes chunky Ranger proportions. Keep helmet, suit construction, provider chest emblem, palette, boots, gloves and facing-right side-on slight3/4 arcade view. Replace weapon only plus necessary hands/arm pose.
CRITICAL RENDERING: authentic hand-placed low-resolution 32-bit-era game SPRITE, not smooth illustration. Working target160x160 logical transparent frame, figure about96 logical pixels tall, uniformly enlarged as square pixel blocks. Clearly visible coarse stair-step edges even at reduced viewing size; every curved contour made of deliberate square steps. Three or four flat shades per material, dark consistent1logical-pixel outlines. No antialiasing, vectorlike smooth outlines, subpixel details, airbrush, gradients, rim glow, dithering noise or glossy illustration. Do not merely add pixel texture over smooth drawing. Keep coherent equal-sized pixel clusters across armor, face, logos, weapon. Large blank transparent margins at least12%; whole figure and all equipment within frame. Upper-left light, neutral combat-ready stance, chest insignia and helmet unobscured. Exactly two arms/two legs; hands visibly grasp the weapon with plausible wrists. No old swords, holsters, effects, shadow, backdrop, labels or text. Genuinely zero-alpha background; opaque sprite interior.
Weapon geometry must be precise: rigid straight shaft/blade centerlines through fittings and hands, restrained construction, no wobbly rods, oversized sunflowers, bulbous toyblades or excessive ornament. Symmetry in the weapon's object plane when intended; intentional curves only when requested.
C2: ONE slender sci-fi katana, gently and intentionally curved single-edged silver blade with narrow lavender spine accent, a small plain rectangular tsuba, longer dark two-tone grip. Continuous modest curvature, crisp controlled bevel and pointed tip. One-handed low-ready diagonal down-right pose, other fist free. No scabbard, secondblade or glow. Silhouette more slender and sweeping than C1.
